Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible Reputed Supplier as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet
(TDS) as well as Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
a) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the electro-¬mechanical works shall be five (05) years.
b) The minimum specific experience of the Supplier at least 01 (One) contract of Supply, Installation & Testing of CCTV System
successfully completed within the last five (5) years (Years/Date counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the e-GP
system) with a value of at least Tk. 27.00 Lac only Government/ Semi-Government/ Autonomous Bodies /Private within
Bangladesh. The issued Private Certificate must be authenticated (verified) by the Executive Engineer of PWD with in his
jurisdiction.
c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Letter of Commitment for Bank’s Undertaking for line of Credit as
per Form PG3-8 of Tender and Contract Forms must be submitted for this Purpose of the successful Tenderer shall not be less
than Tk. 30.00 Lac only. The Supporting Bank Document submitted along with the Tender must be issued in between Publication
date & Submission date of the Tender.
d) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC/BC category Contractor & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh Electrical
Licensing Board.
e) The Tenderer must have up to date Income Tax clearance Certificate from the NBR with TIN up- to-2016-2017 (Tax Year).
f) The Tenderer must have up- to- date VAT Registration Certificate.
g) The Tenderer must have up- to- date valid Trade License.
